daily.today_energy: Your vibe is magnetic today, Aquarius. There's a restless creativity flowing through you that's begging to be channeled into something real. Trust the impulse to shake things up—your unconventional energy is exactly what the moment needs.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the light in you right now. Whether you're single or coupled, authenticity is your love language today. Stop overthinking and let your weird, wonderful self show. That's what draws people in.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. This is a solid time to pitch that project or speak up in meetings. Your perspective brings fresh energy to the table, and the universe is backing your confidence.
daily.health: Your body's asking you to move differently today—maybe try something unconventional or explore a new way to get grounded. Listen to what feels good instead of forcing routines. Your energy peaks when you honor what actually excites you.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to get real with yourself about what you actually want. Mercury's vibes are pushing you toward honest conversations and authentic connections. Trust your gut—it's been trying to tell you something.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, the universe is asking you to lead with vulnerability. That text you've been thinking about sending? The conversation you've been avoiding? This is your week. Real talk hits different right now.
weekly.career: Your ideas have serious potential, but they need your follow-through energy. Don't just think big—start mapping out the smaller steps. Collaboration over solo missions will unlock doors you didn't even know existed.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. Dance, walk, stretch—whatever makes you feel alive. Mental clarity comes when you release what you've been holding onto. Let yourself rest guilt-free too.
